parent_objective: design a replay-admissible controlled-fusion repair objective that protects rejected-history branch failures
blocked_by: all known M944 controlled-fusion candidate alphas fail the same M267/M264 rejected-history rows
invalidates: direct lower-alpha replay gate using M944 alpha 0.0675 or 0.0700 as sufficient repair

public_gates: M948 must preserve the P0 actor-input contract
M948 must design a preflight gate for M267/M264 rows 6/13/15/16 before any full replay gate
forbidden_shortcuts: do not update response/context encoders or GRU in the design unless routing to synthesis first
do not use old key 9944 as a singleton veto
do not run training in the design milestone

workflow_synthesis.evidence_axis: G_replay: rejected-history branch retention after controlled-fusion objective compatibility
workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs the next objective/gate needed because exact objective-compatible controlled-fusion candidates wash out rejected-history branch failures
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: design only; no training, no replay pass claim, no generalization, no promotion
stop_condition: stop if the design cannot express rejected-history terminal sign retention with existing artifacts
stop if the design requires changing actor inputs
stop if the design requires opening encoders or GRU without branch synthesis
fallback_plan: if existing one-step artifacts are insufficient, route to rejected-branch trajectory target export
if controlled-fusion surface cannot retain both normal lift and rejected failure, route to branch synthesis
if a design is feasible, route to a small no-PPO objective-only probe
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M947 classifies candidate failure as rejected-history branch washout across all known candidate alphas

hypothesis: A replay-admissible controlled-fusion repair needs an explicit rejected-history branch retention term and an M267/M264 preflight gate, because low-tail exact compatibility and lower backup alphas do not preserve wrong-history failures.
success_criteria: active rejected-history row set is specified
objective terms are specified separately for normal retention, low-tail lift, and rejected-branch retention
preflight gate and full replay escalation are specified
failure_criteria: design relies on hidden or oracle actor inputs
design recommends PPO before rejected-branch repair
design uses old key 9944 as singleton veto

commands.name: write_design
commands.command: Write the controlled-fusion rejected-branch retention design document and route M949.

decision_rule: M948 may only design the rejected-branch retention route. It must not train, replay a new candidate as promoted, PPO, or promote.
